entries.05ab1b20c513c4c1: The company is a pure holding company headquartered in Shinjuku Ward, Tokyo, and conducts construction service-related business together with its 4 consolidated subsidiaries. As of September 30, 2025, its service network comprised 49 locations nationwide, and consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended September 2025 numbered 591. The company is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

entries.103b653560399f32: This service provides pre- and post-handover inspections of housing, periodic inspections, various maintenance, small-scale renovations, coating, recall response to defects in housing equipment and other issues handled all at once (Refit Service), and a call center that responds to inquiries from homeowners, among others.
entries.114af53d96d68b44: This service provides pre- and post-handover inspections of housing, periodic inspections, various maintenance, small-scale renovations, coating, recall response to defects in housing equipment and other issues handled all at once (Refit Service), and a call center that responds to inquiries from homeowners, among others. The company also provides Tsunageru Cloud, a cloud-based communication tool that helps residential builders maintain relationships with homeowners. Its services are mainly contract-based, of accumulation-type and recurring-type. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥4,148 million.
entries.1985ce6f70a7a06f: Construction services for residential environments, such as home inspections, periodic checks, maintenance and call centers
entries.25c010879e61ef5e: This business sells repair materials and maintenance products, mainly used in repair services, through in-store sales at home centers and mass retailers nationwide and through EC sites, among others. It purchases from domestic manufacturers as well as overseas manufacturers with which it has agency agreements, and it also develops original products in cooperation with domestic paint manufacturers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥667 million.
entries.2f4ccebd6e32afe1: This service restores appearance by partially repairing (repair) scratches and defects in interior and exterior building materials and furniture, making use of the original components without replacing them. Targets include housing as well as commercial facilities, temples and shrines, and cultural heritage. Construction is carried out on site by directly employed technicians trained through the company's own technical education and training program, and by partner companies, including independent former employees. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥4,493 million.
entries.3e8840a21b1237ae: Construction services for commercial environments, such as interior work in commercial facilities, furniture assembly and delivery and installation, and lifting of building materials
entries.3f612e0be2d03a65: The company has a service network of 49 locations nationwide (as of September 30, 2025) and has built a system in which directly employed technicians, trained through its proprietary technical education and training program, work together with partner companies, including former employees who have become independent, to carry out construction. In addition to raising productivity by constantly managing each technician's workload in its system, the company excels at simultaneous, multi-site response, such as recall responses in which defects in residential equipment are addressed nationwide at once.

entries.5360ed31f195d29b: The company has adopted 'Innovation and Creation' as its corporate motto and, based on its group philosophy of 'sharing emotion with society through original building services the world can be proud of,' aims to realize its group vision of 'CANDEAL for every building.' It lists 5 priority issues to address: promoting price increases, expanding labor and construction capacity, improving productivity, promoting alliances, and promoting human capital management, and is working to strengthen its construction system and management foundation.

entries.ef17df9999a24e2c: This business provides services that help with the repair, renovation, maintenance and management of buildings, rather than with the construction of buildings themselves. It consists of the company, a pure holding company, and 4 consolidated subsidiaries, and provides services for buildings such as housing, commercial facilities and offices through a service network of 49 locations nationwide (as of September 30, 2025). It is a single segment, and its services are classified into 4 categories: building services for commercial environments, repair services, building services for residential environments, and product sales. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥13,860 million.
entries.fa80c463052551d9: Revenue from construction services for residential environments
entries.fc7b48d6b7420b3c: This service handles interior construction at commercial facilities and stores, carrying in and installing furniture and fixtures and interior work when offices relocate, assembling and installing furniture, and lifting building materials. It is experienced in handling simultaneous on-site work, such as simultaneous construction across multiple stores and simultaneous entry by multiple contractors, and it flexibly combines full-time employees with a large number of registered staff to respond to sites that need many workers in a short period. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥4,551 million.
entries.fcc999e7efc43d9d: The business is a single segment of construction service-related business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was spread across four services: construction services for commercial environments at ¥4,551 million, repair services at ¥4,493 million, construction services for residential environments at ¥4,148 million, and product sales at ¥667 million. As for the operating environment, while the number of newly built housing starts is declining, demand in the maintenance and renovation market, which aims to keep existing buildings comfortable for longer, and in the commercial environment market is said to be firm.
